change: Consolidated M3 router-hardening RAM-boot build following the v5.6.3 physical hardware milestone (zero panic, full-MTU LuCI + SSH, both 5 GHz RTL8814BR & 2.4 GHz RTL8197G APs UP & forwarding, 5 GHz WPA2-PSK client associated at VHT NSS2-MCS9 780 Mbps with DHCP and 26.5 MiB free RAM): (1) close L2 WAN->LAN firewall bypass by clearing stale 4K CVLAN entries 0..31 (including VLAN 7 members=00ff untag=00ff) inside rtl8367b_setup() on RTL8367S, and declare ucidef_add_switch switch0 topology in 02_network so LuCI Network->Switch shows real ports 0..4 + 6t@eth0; (2) fix Wi-Fi client isolation (block_relay=1) by setting network.lan.multicast_to_unicast='0' and overriding _wireless_set_brsnoop_isolation in rtl8192cd.sh (keeping explicit UCI isolate authoritative), plus printf-safe SSID/PSK emit, explicit coexist=0/1, and wireless_set_retry 0; (3) fix WEXT/libiwinfo/LuCI wireless reporting (rtl_giwfreq real kHz, rtl_giwrange actual channel IDs & IW_MAX_FREQUENCIES clamp, rtl_giwrate VHT/HT rate decode, rtl_giwencode WPA2 NOKEY, new rtl_giwtxpow dBm handler, and RFC 2863 netif_carrier_on/off operstate) and expose rtl8192cd options (country, noscan, beacon_int, dtim_period, hidden, isolate, maxassoc) in LuCI wireless.js while hiding unsupported STA/Ad-Hoc/WEP modes; (4) enable software flow offloading (flow_offloading=1, flow_offloading_hw=0) and uhttpd-mod-lua; (5) fix UART diagnostic RX byte-stealing & mid-line n=512 noise (track consecutive unhandled IRQs only in 8250_dw.c) and silence 32x swnic new-rx/tx + 8x 8367S dump boot log spam; (6) add safe RAM-boot 3s Reset button handler (no jffs2reset), fix rsd0614-survey backslash escapes/BusyBox ip/iwpriv labels, and add read-only mtd0ro/mtd2ro flash-layout + SSH streaming backup-guide; all 6 MTDs stay read-only, pcie1/LEDs disabled, persistent flash NO-GO
